scientific_integrity: Integral homotopy theorem follows from independently argued simplicial cover, contractible intersections and join calculations; standalone finite BFS/boundary checks recorded; known face characterizations credited.
scientific_limitations: Complete bipartite root graph with one attached leaf per root and a,b>=2; no equivariant homotopy or three-plus-part result; full face characterization is known in Wang 2026. Finite checks establish neither infinite statements nor independent review.
title: Mixed-dimensional integral homotopy of bipartite-corona general-position complexes
